value.rationale: The natural moduli problem of projection derivations on radical-cube-zero quantum exterior algebras has a structural jump by characteristic, a parameter-symmetry-conjugacy theorem and complete labeled rank counts in arbitrary n, q and skew parameters. For constant generic skew parameter, monomial rigidity yields 2^n distinct classes in characteristic two versus n+1 in odd characteristic; unlike the earlier commutative truncated symmetric situation this structure is not recovered by arbitrary linear changes of generators. Rank polynomials of idempotent derivations encode image subspaces compatible with Leibniz actions and are finer than existence-only gradings. The output is a complete nontrivial natural classification, not a table slice.
